source.caption: Test results on tabular datasets. Presenting the performance for each model. MSE is presented for the YearPrediction and Rossman datasets, and cross-entropy loss (with 100X factor) is presented for the other datasets. The papers that used these datasets are indicated below the table. The values are the averages of four training runs (lower value is better), along with the standard error of the mean (SEM)
